mapper.sql: c.id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover, c.price, c.address, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.booking_deadline AS bookingDeadline, c.cancel_deadline AS cancelDeadline, c.total_quota AS totalQuota, c.remain_quota AS remainQuota, (c.total_quota - c.remain_quota) AS bookedQuota, c.duration, c.difficulty, c.view_count AS viewCount, c.booking_count AS bookingCount, c.status, c.craftsman_id AS craftsmanId, cr.real_name AS craftsmanName, cr.craft_type AS craftType, c.category_id AS categoryId, cat.name AS categoryName
FROM course c LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = c.craftsman_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id
mapper.select: SELECT , c.audit_status AS auditStatus, c.reject_reason AS rejectReason, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime, c.description, c.detail, u.phone AS craftsmanPhone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.course_id = c.id AND b.status = 0) AS bookingWait, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.course_id = c.id AND b.status = 1) AS bookingPassed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.course_id = c.id AND b.status = 2) AS bookingRejected, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.course_id = c.id AND b.status = 3) AS bookingCanceled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.course_id = c.id AND b.status = 4) AS bookingCheckedIn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.course_id = c.id AND b.status = 5) AS bookingFinished FROM course c LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = c.craftsman_id AND cr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id AND cat.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cr.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.id = #{id}
mapper.update:
